payload.name: Dualstar
payload.description: Features combinations of the tethered Burning Stars and Frozen Stars from the previous battle. Ascian Prime will then cast Fusion Prime to make them collide. If non-tanks are hit by two AoEs at once, they will likely die. To tell the order of the collisions and their AoEs, players must eye the distance of the tethers and the colors of the orbs instead of relying on the orange AoE indicators, which only briefly appears before the AoEs resolve. If the Frozen Stars collide first, stand under them and quickly run away from the imminent detonation of the Burning Stars If the Burning Stars collide first, run away from them and then quickly run under the Frozen Stars before they detonate as well. Instead of waiting for the AoE animations to finish, the ground is safe to walk into once the orange AoE telegraphs disappear. Using Sprint is helpful.

payload.name: Universal Manipulation
payload.description: Causes room-wide damage and five debuffs. As of Patch 6.3, there no portals to hide in and avoid this, and the debuffs will detonate the following mechanics: bleeding Bleeding: Players take damage overtime until the debuff expires. File:ancient circle icon1.png Ancient Circle: Upon expiring, this creates a massive donut AoE around each player. They should stack in the center to ensure the donut AoEs do not spread there. File:dark whispers icon1.png Dark Whispers: Upon expiring, this creates a purple AoE circle on each player, who should spread out to avoid overlapping. File:ancient frost icon1.png Ancient Frost: Upon expiring, the afflicted player will find themselves the victim of a stack marker. File:burning chains icon2.png Burning Chains: Upon expiring, players are chained by pairs and must run away from each other to break them.

payload.name: Arcane Revelation
payload.description: A reprisal of Lahabrea's ultimate from . Ascian Prime becomes untargettable, summons a large Arcane Sphere, and begins siphoning power from it to fill an Ascian Prime's Power gauge. Meanwhile, untargettable Shades of Lahabrea and Igeyorhm periodically appear to unleash mechanics on the party Chilling Cross and Dark Fire II: Igeyorhm's shade creates cross line AoEs from the middle of the arena while Lahabrea's shade places purple AoE circles on players. Dark Blizzard II and Dark Fire II: Igeyorhm's shade creates several frozen line AoEs while Lahabrea's shade places purple AoE circles on players. Shadow Flare: Both Shades cast this at the same time, dealing extra raidwide damage. Annihilation: Heavy raid-wide damage based on how far the Ascian Prime's Power gauge filled. If Ascian Prime was allowed to reach 100%, his attack will wipe the party

payload.name: Toxic Squamae
payload.description: Targets a random player and creates a toxic cloud that tethers to them. If the toxic cloud reaches the player, it explodes, inflicting a stack of Vulnerability Up, dealing damage, and creates a puddle on the ground that inflicts Pollen to players inside of it. If targeted, run around the arena until the cloud dissipates.

payload.name: Ancient Aero
payload.description: Targets a random area with a large circular AoE. After the AoE explodes, a wind orb will be left on the battlefield that will slowly grow upwards, increasing the damage it deals before it explodes, dealing massive damage to each player. A player should step in it to make it explode prematurely, dealing moderate damage; after Ancient Libra is cast at least once, this should be assigned to a player with Earth Resistance Down II to minimize damage.

payload.name: Ancient Holy
payload.description: Winged Lion lifts into the air, becomes untargetable, and casts a circular AoE. An Arcane Sphere spawns on the ground that grows upwards over time before it explodes at the end of the cast, similar to Ancient Aero and Ancient Stone, dealing massive damage to all players. It should be killed immediately. From the second cast onwards, Amdapori Gargoyle adds will spawn; the Sphere is top priority, adds can be ignored until after the Sphere is gone.
